description.value: A full-service hotel in Victoria's Saanich district, the Red Lion Inn & Suites holds the distinction of being the only hotel directly on the Galloping Goose Regional Trail, giving guests immediate trail access for cycling into the city or outward toward Sooke. The property features an outdoor pool, an on-site sports lounge, and an adjacent Cantonese restaurant, along with a complimentary pass to a nearby fitness facility. Major shopping, transit hubs, and multiple grocery options are within easy walking distance.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 32m; rack (13 spaces) at 72m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed facility information. The facilities page explicitly states 'The Red Lion Inn is the only hotel located on the famous Galloping Goose Trail. It gives our guests a unique way to discover Victoria by walking or biking,' confirming strong cycling relevance. No mention of secure bike storage or bike-handling procedures anywhere on the site. Nearby grocery (Walmart, Whole Foods within 5–15 min walk) and on-site/nearby evening food (V Lounge, Jade Fountain Restaurant) are confirmed by the services page; Wi-Fi is confirmed by OSM internet_access=wlan tag and is consistent with the rooms page reference to complimentary amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively bookable hotel with a live reservation system, confirmed open, and directly adjacent to a major cycling trail — clearly useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The hotel's location on the Galloping Goose Trail is explicitly called out on its own facilities page as a unique selling point for walking and biking guests, making this a high-value listing for the cycling directory even though bike-specific storage amenities are not confirmed.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site V Lounge (sports bar) and Jade Fountain Restaurant on the property; multiple restaurants also listed in adjacent Saanich Plaza and Uptown Centre within 5–15 min walk

Nearby grocery.detail: Walmart Supercenter and Whole Foods Market both listed at Uptown Centre within 5–15 minutes walking distance

wow_evidence: The only hotel located on the famous Galloping Goose Trail

price.label: Budget
price.signal: Red Lion budget brand, affordability positioning; shoulder $110-140 (summer Victoria-market swings)
